source_text: Diana?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Diana?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Diana?"

translation: Diano?

source_text: I didn’t expect to see her here.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.I didn’t expect to see her here.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.I didn’t expect to see her here."

translation: Nie spodziewałam się jej tutaj.

source_text: Who was she?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Who was she?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Who was she?"

translation: Kim ona była?

source_text: That was Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx.That was Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx.That was Madalyn."

translation: To była Madalyn.

source_text: Where are my clothes!?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Where are my clothes!?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Where are my clothes!?"

translation: Gdzie moje ubrania!?

source_text: Here, Judy. I have your clothes.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Here, Judy. I have your clothes.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Here, Judy. I have your clothes."

translation: Tutaj, Judy. Mam twoje ubrania.

source_text: Hey! What is he doing here?

structure.raw_value: HrMaOp>.Hey! What is he doing here?
structure.script_literal: "HrMaOp>.Hey! What is he doing here?"

translation: Hej! Co on tu robi?

source_text: I saw Madalyn! She was here!

structure.raw_value: DiWoEx.I saw Madalyn! She was here!
structure.script_literal: "DiWoEx.I saw Madalyn! She was here!"

translation: Widziałam Madalyn! Była tutaj!

source_text: Why the hell is she still here?

structure.raw_value: HrWoOp>.Why the hell is she still here?
structure.script_literal: "HrWoOp>.Why the hell is she still here?"

translation: Czemu, do cholery, wciąż tu jest?

source_text: She still has the soul inside of her.

structure.raw_value: DiWoEx.She still has the soul inside of her.
structure.script_literal: "DiWoEx.She still has the soul inside of her."

translation: Wciąż ma w sobie duszę.

source_text: The soul? What are you talking about?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.The soul? What are you talking about?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.The soul? What are you talking about?"

translation: Duszę? O czym mówisz?

source_text: It doesn’t concern you.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx>.It doesn’t concern you.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx>.It doesn’t concern you."

translation: To cię nie dotyczy.

source_text: What has possessed her? You must tell me.

structure.raw_value: JuWoOp.What has possessed her? You must tell me.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoOp.What has possessed her? You must tell me."

translation: Co nią zawładnęło? Musisz mi powiedzieć.

source_text: She has a demon’s soul inside of her.

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx.She has a demon’s soul inside of her.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx.She has a demon’s soul inside of her."

translation: Ma w sobie duszę demona.

source_text: Sister Judy! You’re safe!

structure.raw_value: ChHaOp.Sister Judy! You’re safe!
structure.script_literal: "ChHaOp.Sister Judy! You’re safe!"

translation: Siostro Judy! Jesteś bezpieczna!

source_text: I don’t know what happened to me. I remember Mother Superior speaking to me.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I don’t know what happened to me. I remember Mother Superior speaking to me.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I don’t know what happened to me. I remember Mother Superior speaking to me."

translation: Nie wiem, co się ze mną stało. Pamiętam, że rozmawiała ze mną Matka Przełożona.

source_text: Mother Superior? She left the church with the other nuns.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx>.Mother Superior? She left the church with the other nuns.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx>.Mother Superior? She left the church with the other nuns."

translation: Matka Przełożona? Opuściła kościół z innymi siostrami.

source_text: She’s talking about Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx.She’s talking about Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx.She’s talking about Madalyn."

translation: Mówi o Madalyn.

source_text: The Mother Superior of Saint Dame University.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The Mother Superior of Saint Dame University.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The Mother Superior of Saint Dame University."

translation: Matka Przełożona Saint Dame University.

source_text: That old woman? You saw her?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp>.That old woman? You saw her?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp>.That old woman? You saw her?"

translation: Ta stara kobieta? Widziałaś ją?

source_text: Yes! She came into the church while you were gone…

structure.raw_value: JuSaEx.Yes! She came into the church while you were gone…
structure.script_literal: "JuSaEx.Yes! She came into the church while you were gone…"

translation: Tak! Weszła do kościoła, gdy was nie było…

source_text: I was frightened, but I do not remember much of what happened next.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.I was frightened, but I do not remember much of what happened next.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.I was frightened, but I do not remember much of what happened next."

translation: Przestraszyłam się, ale niewiele pamiętam z tego, co było potem.

source_text: I can take a wild guess.

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe>.I can take a wild guess.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnDe>.I can take a wild guess."

translation: Mogę się domyślić.

source_text: She’s a succubus. Her goal is sex.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx^.She’s a succubus. Her goal is sex.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx^.She’s a succubus. Her goal is sex."

translation: Ona jest sukubem. Jej celem jest seks.

source_text: I felt it… A sinful desire.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.I felt it… A sinful desire.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.I felt it… A sinful desire."

translation: Poczułam to… Grzeszne pragnienie.

source_text: Are you telling me that she’s a demon?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe>.Are you telling me that she’s a demon?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe>.Are you telling me that she’s a demon?"

translation: Mówisz, że ona jest demonem?

source_text: A demi-demon.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.A demi-demon.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.A demi-demon."

translation: Pół-demonem.

source_text: I know I’m a priest, but color me skeptical.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe>.I know I’m a priest, but color me skeptical.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe>.I know I’m a priest, but color me skeptical."

translation: Wiem, że jestem księdzem, ale pozwól, że będę sceptyczny.

source_text: It’s all true.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.It’s all true.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.It’s all true."

translation: To wszystko prawda.

source_text: And who are you?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe>.And who are you?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe>.And who are you?"

translation: A ty kim jesteś?

source_text: They are Guild people… Thieves.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.They are Guild people… Thieves.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.They are Guild people… Thieves."

translation: To ludzie Gildii… Złodzieje.

source_text: We don’t work for the Guild!

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe^.We don’t work for the Guild!
structure.script_literal: "HrAnDe^.We don’t work for the Guild!"

translation: Nie pracujemy dla Gildii!

source_text: Diana does. You can’t hide it. I saw the files.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Diana does. You can’t hide it. I saw the files.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Diana does. You can’t hide it. I saw the files."

translation: Diana pracuje. Nie ukryjesz tego. Widziałem akta.

source_text: That was a past life…

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx.That was a past life…
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx.That was a past life…"

translation: To było poprzednie życie…

source_text: And now you’re here to kill Duncan.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.And now you’re here to kill Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.And now you’re here to kill Duncan."

translation: I teraz jesteście tu, by zabić Duncana.

source_text: There is a demonic presence here. I’ve had visions of it.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.There is a demonic presence here. I’ve had visions of it.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.There is a demonic presence here. I’ve had visions of it."

translation: Jest tu demoniczna obecność. Miałam jej wizje.

source_text: Whatever is here, it tried to brainwash Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp>.Whatever is here, it tried to brainwash Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp>.Whatever is here, it tried to brainwash Sister Judy."

translation: Cokolwiek tu jest, próbowało zrobić pranie mózgu siostrze Judy.

source_text: It must be true. Father Parker… He was a monster.

structure.raw_value: JuSaCl.It must be true. Father Parker… He was a monster.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaCl.It must be true. Father Parker… He was a monster."

translation: To musi być prawda. Ojciec Parker… Był potworem.

source_text: The priest you thought you knew was a demon named Daemalius.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.The priest you thought you knew was a demon named Daemalius.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.The priest you thought you knew was a demon named Daemalius."

translation: Ksiądz, którego myślałaś, że znasz, był demonem o imieniu Daemalius.

source_text: Madalyn was his sister and she took his soul…

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx.Madalyn was his sister and she took his soul…
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx.Madalyn was his sister and she took his soul…"

translation: Madalyn była jego siostrą i zabrała jego duszę…

source_text: That is how she’s able to move in and out of our world.

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe.That is how she’s able to move in and out of our world.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe.That is how she’s able to move in and out of our world."

translation: Dzięki temu może przenikać między naszym światem.

source_text: She moves in and out of our world?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe>.She moves in and out of our world?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe>.She moves in and out of our world?"

translation: Przenika między naszymi światami?

source_text: Think of it as teleportation.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.Think of it as teleportation.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.Think of it as teleportation."

translation: Pomyśl o tym jak o teleportacji.

source_text: It’s true. I saw it too.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.It’s true. I saw it too.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.It’s true. I saw it too."

translation: To prawda. Też to widziałam.

source_text: This all sounds super scary!

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.This all sounds super scary!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.This all sounds super scary!"

translation: To wszystko brzmi super strasznie!

source_text: But why would she want Sister Judy?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But why would she want Sister Judy?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But why would she want Sister Judy?"

translation: Ale czemu chciałaby siostry Judy?

source_text: If what you say is true, we’re not exactly friendly with demonic spirits.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx>.If what you say is true, we’re not exactly friendly with demonic spirits.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx>.If what you say is true, we’re not exactly friendly with demonic spirits."

translation: Jeśli to, co mówisz, jest prawdą, nie jesteśmy zbyt przyjaźni demonicznym duchom.

source_text: I’ve never performed an exorcism, but…

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe>.I’ve never performed an exorcism, but…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe>.I’ve never performed an exorcism, but…"

translation: Nigdy nie odprawiałem egzorcyzmu, ale…

source_text: You think she’s afraid of you?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.You think she’s afraid of you?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.You think she’s afraid of you?"

translation: Myślisz, że się ciebie boi?

source_text: My guess is as good as yours. But I’m not going to feel safe knowing a teleporting monster is roaming the woods.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp>.My guess is as good as yours. But I’m not going to feel safe knowing a teleporting monster is roaming the woods.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp>.My guess is as good as yours. But I’m not going to feel safe knowing a teleporting monster is roaming the woods."

translation: Tyle wiem, co ty. Ale nie będę czuć się bezpiecznie, wiedząc, że teleportujący się potwór grasuje po lesie.

source_text: Diana… Do you think she’s looking for us?

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp^.Diana… Do you think she’s looking for us?
structure.script_literal: "HrBaOp^.Diana… Do you think she’s looking for us?"

translation: Diana… Myślisz, że ona nas szuka?

source_text: What more can she want from us?

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx.What more can she want from us?
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx.What more can she want from us?"

translation: Czego więcej może od nas chcieć?

source_text: Sounds like Sister Judy isn’t the only one that has a history with Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe>.Sounds like Sister Judy isn’t the only one that has a history with Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe>.Sounds like Sister Judy isn’t the only one that has a history with Madalyn."

translation: Wygląda na to, że siostra Judy nie jest jedyną, która ma przeszłość z Madalyn.

source_text: Madalyn is connected to the Guild.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Madalyn is connected to the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Madalyn is connected to the Guild."

translation: Madalyn jest powiązana z Gildią.

source_text: Because her husband was an Eclipse Guild leader…

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Because her husband was an Eclipse Guild leader…
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Because her husband was an Eclipse Guild leader…"

translation: Bo jej mąż był przywódcą Gildii Zaćmienia…

source_text: Charles Wilkes.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Charles Wilkes.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Charles Wilkes."

translation: Charles Wilkes.

source_text: Congratulations, detective. Looks like you’ve figured it out.

structure.raw_value: DiFlOp.Congratulations, detective. Looks like you’ve figured it out.
structure.script_literal: "DiFlOp.Congratulations, detective. Looks like you’ve figured it out."

translation: Gratulacje, detektywie. Wygląda na to, że rozgryzłeś to.

source_text: I don’t get it. Madalyn comes here to use Charles and then kill him.

structure.raw_value: HrBaDe^.I don’t get it. Madalyn comes here to use Charles and then kill him.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaDe^.I don’t get it. Madalyn comes here to use Charles and then kill him."

translation: Nie rozumiem. Madalyn przychodzi tu, wykorzystuje Charlesa, a potem go zabija.

source_text: What did she gain from him and why is she still here?

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe^.What did she gain from him and why is she still here?
structure.script_literal: "HrAnDe^.What did she gain from him and why is she still here?"

translation: Co na nim zyskała i czemu wciąż tu jest?

source_text: I’m on the case. But it would help if you were honest with me.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m on the case. But it would help if you were honest with me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m on the case. But it would help if you were honest with me."

translation: Prowadzę sprawę. Ale byłoby łatwiej, gdybyś była ze mną szczera.

source_text: If you think we’re thieves, then why would we tell you anything?

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe^.If you think we’re thieves, then why would we tell you anything?
structure.script_literal: "HrAnDe^.If you think we’re thieves, then why would we tell you anything?"

translation: Jeśli uważasz, że jesteśmy złodziejami, to czemu mielibyśmy ci cokolwiek mówić?

source_text: Are you?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Are you?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Are you?"

translation: A jesteście?

source_text: You know why we’re here… We’re here for Duncan.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx.You know why we’re here… We’re here for Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx.You know why we’re here… We’re here for Duncan."

translation: Wiesz, dlaczego tu jesteśmy… Jesteśmy tu dla Duncana.

source_text: You think the Guild is dying? It’s only changing leadership.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx^.You think the Guild is dying? It’s only changing leadership.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx^.You think the Guild is dying? It’s only changing leadership."

translation: Myślisz, że Gildia umiera? Tylko zmienia przywództwo.

source_text: So Duncan is taking over where Charles left off?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.So Duncan is taking over where Charles left off?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.So Duncan is taking over where Charles left off?"

translation: Więc Duncan przejmuje tam, gdzie skończył Charles?

source_text: Yes. Isn’t it obvious?

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.Yes. Isn’t it obvious?
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.Yes. Isn’t it obvious?"

translation: Tak. Czy to nie oczywiste?

source_text: If Charles was a Guild leader, where are his subordinates? Where are the other Guild members?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.If Charles was a Guild leader, where are his subordinates? Where are the other Guild members?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.If Charles was a Guild leader, where are his subordinates? Where are the other Guild members?"

translation: Jeśli Charles był przywódcą Gildii, gdzie są jego podwładni? Gdzie są pozostali członkowie Gildii?

source_text: The Guild is still operating here. And it’s not going away until Duncan Helmer is dead.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx.The Guild is still operating here. And it’s not going away until Duncan Helmer is dead.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx.The Guild is still operating here. And it’s not going away until Duncan Helmer is dead."

translation: Gildia wciąż tu działa. I nie zniknie, dopóki Duncan Helmer nie zginie.

source_text: Come on, Diana. We don’t need his help.

structure.raw_value: HrAnOp^.Come on, Diana. We don’t need his help.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnOp^.Come on, Diana. We don’t need his help."

translation: Chodź, Diano. Nie potrzebujemy jego pomocy.

source_text: I can grant you immunity.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I can grant you immunity.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I can grant you immunity."

translation: Mogę załatwić wam immunitet.

source_text: Nice try, detective.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.Nice try, detective.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.Nice try, detective."

translation: Niezła próba, detektywie.

source_text: We don’t believe you.

structure.raw_value: HrAnOp^.We don’t believe you.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnOp^.We don’t believe you."

translation: Nie wierzymy ci.

source_text: Are they working on the same case as you, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.Are they working on the same case as you, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.Are they working on the same case as you, 1Hero?"

translation: Czy oni pracują nad tą samą sprawą co ty, 1Hero?

source_text: Those people aren’t detectives, dear.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.Those people aren’t detectives, dear.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.Those people aren’t detectives, dear."

translation: Ci ludzie nie są detektywami, kochanie.

source_text: They have connections to a criminal organization.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.They have connections to a criminal organization.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.They have connections to a criminal organization."

translation: Mają powiązania z organizacją przestępczą.

source_text: You didn’t arrest them?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.You didn’t arrest them?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.You didn’t arrest them?"

translation: Nie aresztowałeś ich?

source_text: This case is complicated. It’s hard to explain.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.This case is complicated. It’s hard to explain.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.This case is complicated. It’s hard to explain."

translation: Ta sprawa jest skomplikowana. Trudno wyjaśnić.

source_text: Going off the books, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.Going off the books, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.Going off the books, 1Hero?"

translation: Działasz poza protokołem, 1Hero?

source_text: Come on. Let’s get Sister Judy back inside.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Come on. Let’s get Sister Judy back inside.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Come on. Let’s get Sister Judy back inside."

translation: Chodź. Odprowadźmy siostrę Judy do środka.

source_text: Thank you for coming to my rescue. I am fortunate to have such caring people in my life.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Thank you for coming to my rescue. I am fortunate to have such caring people in my life.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Thank you for coming to my rescue. I am fortunate to have such caring people in my life."

translation: Dziękuję, że przyszliście mi na ratunek. Mam szczęście, że mam w życiu tak troskliwych ludzi.

source_text: Of course, Judy. We couldn’t let anything bad happen to you.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Of course, Judy. We couldn’t let anything bad happen to you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Of course, Judy. We couldn’t let anything bad happen to you."

translation: Oczywiście, Judy. Nie mogliśmy pozwolić, by stało ci się coś złego.

source_text: Those bees look angry. I better keep my distance.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Those bees look angry. I better keep my distance.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Those bees look angry. I better keep my distance."

translation: Te pszczoły wyglądają na wściekłe. Lepiej trzymać dystans.

source_text: I can use my blow torch to smoke out the bees.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can use my blow torch to smoke out the bees.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can use my blow torch to smoke out the bees."

translation: Mogę użyć palnika, żeby wykurzyć pszczoły dymem.
